name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 5 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-11-13, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.25 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
